description:
One sample of the numbers that matter for a Redis server. A field is `None`
when the cloud did not return that metric in the window.

connectedClients.description: Connected clients at the end of the window.

evictions.description: Keys evicted during the sampled window.

memoryUsedPercent.description: Memory used as a percentage of the configured maximum (0-100).

replicationLagSeconds.description: Replication lag in seconds, when a replica exists.
